title: feat(research): certify the joint integer rank-cap ceiling of the complex local mass
body:
## Summary

The rank-cap continuation of the selected complex local word's packing ceiling prices the local
paid mass with integer child counts but leaves the idle remainder in a **fractional** block
(`1646/51` rank-51 children). Its integrality-loss column therefore measures only half of the
rounding, and its ceilings are not attainable by any real packing.

This package computes the **attained optimum over joint integer packings** for every cap
`s = 1..51` the outer halving guard allows: local paid mass 5586 in integer children of rank
`<= s`, idle remainder 1646 in integer children of rank `<= 51`, both by dynamic programming over
the mass axis. Every cap is certified in both directions: an explicit joint integer packing whose
certified moment is below one, and a certified lower bound of *every* joint packing above one.

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| Cap at which the joint integer class first clears `a = 1/99` | **44** (cap 43 fails at 0.00993809) |
| Joint ceiling at cap 44 | `a = 0.01031470`, `κ ≤ 0.01020939`, ×6.10 selected κ |
| Joint ceiling at the guard cap 51 | `a = 0.01349051`, `κ ≤ 0.01331094`, ×7.96 selected κ |
| Worst integrality loss on the curve | **1.35033 %** (paid rounding 0.66054 % + idle rounding 0.68979 %) |

So the rank-shape consequence survives integrality — the target is cleared at cap 44 on an
attainable object — but the guard-cap figure is 0.99 % lower than the fractional-idle reading and
the worst-case integrality loss is about 2.04× the published figure that counts paid-mass rounding
only.

Controls include: the class relaxation equals the pinned parent `ceiling()` on the reshaped
profile at caps 8, 16 and 51 (the parent's rank-8 and rank-16 lever rows); the cited live column is
reproduced independently at its own grid at caps 44 and 51; the paid dynamic-program optimum equals
the largest-first greedy cost **and histogram** at all 51 caps, extending a recorded 11-cap check;
both histograms conserve mass and respect their caps at every cap; brackets are witnessed on both
sides; 25 sampled joint packings per cap never reach the rejected saving; and the 1e-8 bracket
contains the 1e-12 bracket at three caps.

Scoped bound inside the parent ceiling model, with one fixed paid local mass, one fixed idle
remainder, `m = 73`, 896 families over nine stages, centre charge 64, the coverage law and the
halving guard. No new κ, no supplier, no change to the selected frontier.

## Related open work

Three open peer packages price the same selected complex local word in the same parent ceiling
model; none is modified here and each is cited for comparison only.

- **#3729 `research/complex-idle-integrality-ceiling`** — incumbent paid profile, integral idle
  counts per call, optimum `{51: 32, 14: 1}`, ceiling `a < 0.001688603446527`. **Agreement:** this
  package uses exactly that idle packing at every cap and the same per-call premise. **Differs:**
  #3729 re-optimises the idle remainder of the incumbent word; the cap-`s` rows here reshape the
  *paid* mass into rank-`s` children, so the cap-8 row `0.00273511` is the integer-idle version of
  the parent's rank-8 lever row, not #3729's incumbent ceiling.
- **#3805 `research/idle-rank-cap-sensitivity`** — sweeps the idle *rank cap* and separates
  aggregate pooling (`4647×51 + 27` at cap 51, `+0.870319 %`) from a per-call-forced optimum
  (`32×51 + 14` per call, `+0.784307 %`). **This package uses the per-call premise throughout**
  (each call packs its own integral `1646`), so its rows belong with #3805's per-call row and with
  #3729 and are **not** comparable with #3805's aggregate rows. The axes are complementary: #3805
  varies the idle cap at a fixed paid word, this package varies the largest *paid* child rank with
  the idle cap held at the guard.
- **#3799 `research/complex-paid-mass-budget`** — free removal of paid mass at fixed rank shape.
  Its full-elimination endpoint `0.013675160009708` is **the same object as this package's cap-51
  class relaxation**, and that agreement is registered as a control (below `1e-9`); its `φ = 0` row
  is the parent's inherited ceiling `0.001690054109089`. **Differs:** its `1/99` threshold
  `φ ≥ 92.7698485 %` is a mass-removal budget, whereas cap 44 here clears `1/99` with **no mass
  removed**, by delivering the same paid mass in rank-`≤44` children. Same model, same target,
  different lever; neither statement bounds the other.
